title: Change or determination of IMS registration status

entities.name: IMS registration status change procedure
entities.description: Procedure executed by UE when IMS registration status changes or is determined, involving mode transitions and capability management.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-TO-UPDATE-MM
entities.description: EMM state where UE is registered but attempting to update mobility management.

entities.name: UE is not available for voice calls in the IMS indication
entities.description: Condition indicating UE cannot receive voice calls via IMS.

entities.name: Voice domain preference for E-UTRAN is "IMS PS voice preferred, CS Voice as secondary"
entities.description: Condition indicating UE prefers IMS PS voice with CS voice as fallback.

entities.name: SMS configuration is set to prefer to use SMS over IP networks
entities.description: Condition indicating UE prefers SMS over IP networks.

entities.name: CS fallback is not available
entities.description: Condition indicating CS fallback is unavailable, includes EMM causes #16, #17, and #18.

entities.name: Disable the E-UTRA capability
entities.description: Action to disable E-UTRA capability as specified in clause 4.5.

entities.name: Combined tracking area update with IMSI attach
entities.description: Procedure to transit to CS/PS mode with combined tracking area update and IMSI attach.

entities.name: Combined tracking area update with "SMS only"
entities.description: Procedure to transit to CS/PS mode with combined tracking area update for SMS only.

relations.description: IMS registration status change procedure is triggered by IMS unavailability condition.
IMS registration status change procedure includes combined TAU with IMSI attach as a step.
IMS registration status change procedure includes disabling E-UTRA capability as a step.
IMS unavailability condition combined with voice preference condition triggers specific procedures.
IMS unavailability condition combined with SMS over IP preference condition triggers specific procedures.
IMS unavailability condition combined with CS fallback unavailability condition triggers E-UTRA capability disable.
IMS unavailability condition requires UE to be in EMM-REGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-TO-UPDATE-MM state for optional E-UTRA disable.
IMS registration status change procedure includes combined TAU with SMS only as a step.
